categories.main_business_segments: Lonking Holdings Limited primarily operates in the sale of construction machinery, finance leasing of construction machinery, and financial investment. Its main product lines include wheel loaders, forklifts, excavators, road rollers, and related components. The company also engages in finance leasing services for construction machinery.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes technological innovation and quality control in manufacturing construction machinery. It invests in R&D for electric loaders, core components such as axles, gearboxes, cylinders, gears, castings, forgings, and high-end hydraulic pumps and valves. Production is supported by a vertically integrated supply chain and advanced quality management systems including 4M and poka yoke management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Lonking serves customers in the construction, infrastructure, logistics, and warehousing sectors. Its products are widely used in domestic construction and infrastructure projects as well as international markets. The company’s forklifts cater to logistics and warehousing industries, while wheel loaders and excavators serve construction and agricultural applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Mainland China with significant sales across various regions including Northwest, Southwest, Central, South, North, East, and Northeast China. It has a growing export business with international markets contributing approximately 31% of total revenue, reflecting expansion in overseas markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Lonking operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, manufacturing and distributing construction machinery and components. It maintains a vertically integrated supply chain with strategic partnerships with over 1,400 qualified suppliers, focusing on supply chain efficiency, quality control, and risk management.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on high-quality development, innovation in green, intelligent, and high-end products, and expanding its product portfolio with independent intellectual property rights. It prioritizes R&D in electric machinery, core components, and quality improvements to enhance international competitiveness and meet evolving market demands.
categories.revenue_model: Lonking generates revenue primarily through the sale of construction machinery products including wheel loaders, forklifts, excavators, and road rollers. Additional revenue streams include finance lease interest income and financial investments. Revenue recognition is based on point-in-time transfer of goods to customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Lonking holds a leading market position in China’s construction machinery industry, with loaders ranking top in domestic production and sales, and forklifts maintaining a top-three industry status. It competes with other domestic and international construction machinery manufacturers, leveraging cost-effectiveness and rapid service response to gain market share overseas.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Lonking reported revenue of approximately RMB10.2 billion, a slight decrease of 3% year-on-year, with net profit increasing by 58% to RMB1.019 billion. The company maintains a strong financial position with a gearing ratio of about 31%, net assets of RMB10.7 billion, and steady growth in export sales. EBITDA and operating profits showed significant improvement, reflecting enhanced profitability and operational efficiency.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Lonking differentiates itself through high-quality, cost-effective construction machinery with a focus on innovation, especially in electric and new energy products. It offers shorter delivery times and faster service response compared to European and American competitors, emphasizing quality control, customer service, and a comprehensive product portfolio tailored to both domestic and international markets.
